address: Av. Paseo De La Reforma, 297, Cuauhtémoc, 06500, Mexico
bio: Nestled on the ground floor of the Sofitel, Bajel boasts a prime location with stunning views. It's a French brand so they may whisper bonsoir, but one look at the menu and it's clear they're firmly planted here. Inside this sophisticated setting, the fully open kitchen demands your attention. Both a la carte and the tasting menu highlight contemporary Mexican-leaning cuisine with many nods to smoked meats and Spanish influences. Dishes like enchilada de pato confitado, tortilla de epazote and abodo de guajillo are as traditional (and enjoyable) as they come. Barbacoa is tender and plentiful, while dessert is a Basque-style tart with peach ice cream....
